SELECT
  topic,
  ARG_MAX(opened, opened_timestamp) AS opened,
  ARG_MAX(closed, closed_timestamp) AS closed,
  ARG_MAX(hmi_cmd_open, hmi_cmd_open_timestamp) AS hmi_cmd_open,
  ARG_MAX(hmi_cmd_close, hmi_cmd_close_timestamp) AS hmi_cmd_close,
  ARG_MAX(should_be_open, should_be_open_timestamp) AS should_be_open,
  ARG_MAX(hmi_control_available, hmi_control_available_timestamp) AS hmi_control_available,
  ARG_MAX(open, open_timestamp) AS open,
  ARG_MAX(close, close_timestamp) AS close,
  ARG_MAX(alarm, alarm_timestamp) AS alarm
FROM marpower.bilge_fifi_updates
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY topic
